name: Seven Sisters
text: Seven Sisters (Welsh: Blaendulais: source of the (river) Dulais) is a village and community in the Dulais Valley, Wales, UK. It lies 10 miles (16 km) north-east of Neath. Seven Sisters falls within the Seven Sisters ward of Neath Port Talbot county borough.

depictions.name: Seven Sisters
depictions.text: Seven Sisters, Sussex The Seven Sisters are a series of chalk cliffs in Sussex, England by the English Channel. Being free of any modern development and allowed to erode naturally, the cliff has often been used as a stand-in for the White Cliffs of Dover in Kent.
